A not-for-profit for South Tamil Nadu, it grew from ~20 angels to 200+ investors with six local chapters (Madurai, Coimbatore, Erode, Karur, Trichy, Thoothukudi).

summary.en: Marwari Catalysts, founded in 2019 in Rajasthan, is an angel network + accelerator focused on Tier-2 and Tier-3 city startups. It has 100+ portfolio startups and runs the 12-week 'Thrive' accelerator providing mentorship, investor access and signal funding.
